title: Apple More Likely To Introduce Its First 1.4nm Chips In Two Years As TSMC Races To Mass Production Stage In H1 2028, Trying To Prevent AI Outstripping Supply
content: TSMC’s latest lithography is typically adopted by Apple in its A-series chipsets to gain a competitive edge in the industry, but on this occasion, the company may be moving to a new manufacturing process out of desperation. As leading-edge chip shipments grow in demand thanks to the AI boom, analysts believe TSMC will race to commence mass production of its 1.4nm node in the first half of 2028, making it almost certain that Apple will unveil the A22 Pro on the same technology the following year.
